title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: National Cherry Festival, Traverse City | 1995
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the National Cherry Festival in Traverse City, Michigan, USA, on 11 July 1995.

It was the 19th show by the third All-Starr Band. Their tour of Japan and North America lasted for 50 dates between June and August 1995.

The third All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, piano
  • Randy Bachman: vocals, guitar
  • Mark Farner: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Billy Preston: vocals, keyboards
  • Felix Cavaliere: vocals, organ, keyboard, maracas
  • John Entwistle: vocals, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, tambourine, cowbell, guitar
  • Zak Starkey: drums
